content: Unofficial WhatsApp (Baileys) automation carries permanent-ban risk; bans are behaviour-triggered (bursts, identical messages, no opt-in). Vendor guidance converges on randomised delays roughly 15-90s between sends plus a longer pause after every ~10-50 messages. Meta Cloud API is the only sanctioned bulk path but requires template approval — not viable for posting into ordinary groups (Cloud API cannot post to groups at all).
